blurb: The city of a hundred spires, where emperors kept astronomers and Kafka wrote at night.

facts.t: Emperor Rudolf II brought the astronomer Tycho Brahe to Prague in 1599; Kepler joined him in 1600. After Tycho died in 1601, Kepler used his observations to find the laws of planetary motion.
Franz Kafka was born by the Old Town Square in 1883 and worked by day for an insurance institute. He asked his friend Max Brod to burn his manuscripts; Brod published them instead.
